about: Mumbai's curated corridor network (City Pack cities/mumbai/): the junctions (landmarks.json ids and spellings where the junction is a landmark; English + Marathi names), the segments along the real OpenStreetMap roads between them, the station selection and the camera rules. scripts/gen_osm_network.py --city mumbai resolves every junction to the OSM node where its roads meet (nearest its anchor), traces every segment along its roads (one-ways honoured), and writes the seed SQL, scripts/data/osm_network.json (evidence), scripts/data/osm_network_map.json (the resolved table) and cities/mumbai/network.json. Road data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0.
